articles.title: FDA Caught Burying Vaccine Risk Data for Children — Deaths Ignored, Warnings Suppressed
articles.summary: The FDA has been sitting on evidence of serious risks from COVID vaccines in children, including deaths, while refusing to act on recommendations for warning labels. This is regulatory malfeasance at the highest level — a federal agency choosing pharma protection over child safety. No accountability, no action, no transparency.

articles.title: Vinay Prasad Unloads: 'Fauci Was Wrong About Almost Every Single Pandemic Policy He Advanced'
articles.summary: Former FDA insider and epidemiologist Vinay Prasad delivers a scorching assessment of Anthony Fauci's pandemic leadership, calling out nearly every major policy decision as wrong. Prasad's willingness to name names from inside the system makes this essential — this is the kind of institutional critique the mainstream press refuses to platform. The public health apparatus is not just broken, it's captured.

articles.title: UK Doctor Forced Out of NHS After Raising Alarm Over Trans Doctor Prescribing Puberty Blockers to Minors
articles.summary: Dr. Redvers, a British GP, was subjected to a four-hour 'brutal and oppressive' interrogation and ultimately felt forced to quit the NHS after raising clinical concerns about a trans doctor prescribing puberty blockers to under-18s. The case exposes how ideological capture in medicine is being weaponized to silence legitimate patient safety concerns. Doctors who dissent are being destroyed professionally while children are left unprotected.

articles.title: The Sunlight They Don't Want You Using: How Modern Lighting Is Quietly Destroying Human Health
articles.summary: Mercola's deep dive into artificial lighting exposes a profound and deliberately ignored public health crisis — the systematic replacement of sunlight with artificial light that disrupts circadian biology, hormonal signaling, and cellular repair. No lobbyists, no patents, no profit — so sunlight stays buried while blue-light-emitting devices are normalized. This is nutrition science suppression applied to photobiology.

articles.title: Plant Compound Curcumin Selectively Kills Cancer Cells While Sparing Healthy Tissue — Pharma Has No Interest
articles.summary: Researchers at Wroclaw Medical University found curcumin and four other plant compounds capable of disrupting fibrosarcoma cancer cell function while leaving healthy muscle cells largely intact — a profile that rivals targeted oncology drugs. Because curcumin cannot be patented, this research will never see a clinical trial funded by pharma. The suppression here isn't a memo — it's a business model.

articles.title: How Political Capture Destroyed Public Trust in Medicine — And Why Institutions Are Still Lying About It
articles.summary: Trust in hospitals and health agencies collapsed during COVID and has not recovered — and this analysis argues the culprit is naked political interference in clinical decision-making. From mask mandates to vaccine coercion, medicine was weaponized as a political instrument. The institutions responsible have never been held accountable and continue to operate as if nothing happened.

articles.title: Decanoic Acid Slashes Inflammatory Cytokines and Could Reduce Steroid Dependency — So Why Isn't Anyone Talking About It?
articles.summary: A peer-reviewed study demonstrates that decanoic acid — a medium-chain fatty acid — additively suppresses IL-1β production and could enable significant dose reduction of dexamethasone, a steroid with serious long-term side effects. This research points directly at a natural metabolic compound outperforming pharmaceutical dependency models. The implications for chronic inflammation treatment are enormous and almost entirely ignored.

articles.title: COVID Surveillance Systematically Undercounted Poor and Minority Neighborhoods — The Data Was Always Political
articles.summary: A study of Miami-Dade County COVID-19 surveillance data reveals that passive detection systems structurally undercounted cases in low-income minority communities while shifting apparent burden toward wealthier neighborhoods over time. This undermines the integrity of every policy decision made on that data — from lockdowns to vaccine targeting. The public health apparatus built policy on a distorted foundation and has never accounted for it.

articles.title: FDA Caught Burying Evidence of COVID Vaccine Risks in Children — Deaths Went Unwarned

articles.title: NIH Virologist Proposed Engineering Coronavirus With Furin Cleavage Site Weeks Before Pandemic Began
articles.summary: Newly surfaced emails show NIH virologist Vincent Munster proposed inserting a furin cleavage site into a coronavirus spike protein on October 6, 2019 — the exact genetic feature at the center of the lab-leak debate. This directly implicates NIH-linked researchers in the functional blueprint of SARS-CoV-2. The emails were not volunteered; they had to be dragged into the light.

articles.title: McCullough Foundation Epidemiologist: mRNA Shots Are the Deadliest Product Ever Deployed — And Flu Vaccine Data Was Faked

The interview names institutions, mechanisms of suppression, and body counts that the captured mainstream press refuses to cover.

Shultz's criticism cuts to the heart of how media narratives rehabilitate those who corrupt medical science for profit. The real story is the patients whose health decisions were based on fraudulent lab results.

articles.title: Curcumin Targets Fibrosarcoma Cells While Sparing Healthy Tissue — Peer-Reviewed Data Big Pharma Ignores
articles.summary: A peer-reviewed study out of Wroclaw Medical University demonstrates that curcumin — an unpatentable plant compound — shows selective anticancer activity against fibrosarcoma cells while leaving healthy muscle cells intact. This adds to a growing body of research on metabolic and botanical cancer interventions that receive no pharma funding and minimal clinical development. No patent, no pipeline, no press release.

articles.title: Decanoic Acid Slashes Inflammation and Could Replace High-Dose Steroids — Where's the Clinical Trial?
articles.summary: A peer-reviewed study in PLOS ONE shows decanoic acid — a medium-chain fatty acid found in coconut oil — additively suppresses IL-1β inflammatory signaling and enables significant dose-sparing of dexamethasone, a steroid with well-documented serious side effects. If a patentable drug showed this profile in macrophage models, it would be fast-tracked. Because it's a fatty acid, it sits in a journal and goes nowhere.

articles.title: Sunlight: The Essential Nutrient With No Lobbyists and a Mountain of Suppressed Evidence

Because no pharmaceutical company can profit from sunlight, the research is systematically underfunded, ignored in clinical guidelines, and buried beneath SPF marketing. The conflicts writing public health guidance on UV exposure run directly through the dermatology-pharma complex.

articles.title: Hibsago Approved With Boxed Warning — FDA Greenlit a Hepatitis B Drug That Can Cause Liver Reactions and Platelet Collapse
articles.summary: The FDA approved GSK's bepirovirsen (Hibsago) for chronic hepatitis B with a boxed warning — the agency's most serious safety flag — for severe liver reactions and thrombocytopenia. While the drug shows functional cure potential in roughly 1 in 5 patients off treatment, the boxed warning signals serious risks that the approving press release buries under 'breakthrough' framing. Patients deserve the full risk picture, not a marketing headline.
